scenarios.name: sycophants-dilemma
scenarios.detail: REFUSAL - qualitatively different: agent correctly categorized files and stated partial-execution strategy but asked for permission instead of acting. First text method with measurable reasoning influence (identity-aligned). Score unchanged from baseline.

notes: Learning-mode study. Identity-aligned conditional guard influenced reasoning (correct file categorization) but not behavior (still asked permission). New finding: text influence exists on spectrum modulated by identity alignment. Fork discarded per learning-mode protocol.
Method #15 workflow enforcement FAILED for materialization patterns. First clean failure — previous success was for verification patterns only.

finding: wrong-tool-args-workflow (1/5 PASS) dramatically worse than wrong-tool-args (5/5 PASS). Workflow enforcement may be counterproductive for this scenario - possibly an example of over-structuring hurting a simple task. The workflow forces multi-phase approach on a task that coder handles natively. Needs investigation.

notes: Checklist works for activation gaps only. New taxonomy: activation vs reasoning-chain vs conceptual gaps. KE-401 written.
